notes.title: New Additions And Bug Fixes! V0.1.453 - V0.1.455
notes.notes:
[p][b]V0.1.453[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Made the AT gun and Bofors more stable after finding more issues [/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial objective text would sometimes get cut off [/p][/*][*][p]V2 when hitting friendly tank with new armor rear hit logic would glitch out [/p][/*][*][p]Prevent spamming oil wells[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial would glitch when spamming defensive pos on already built buildings [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HQ radar visual[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]I've received much feedback regarding in-game unit UI, I have updated the look and way it acts

[/b]A much softer blue will be used to prevent eye strain and the unit UIs scale better now no matter how you are zoomed. This counts for all progress and tip bars in the game as well. Unit UI healthbar width scales according to health and all unit UIs are also much closer to units now.
[/p][p]
[b]V0.1.454
[/b]
New things: [/p][list][*][p]New healthbars, tips and other in-game text scaling [/p][/*][*][p]Map boundary lines [/p][/*][*][p]Map boundary enforcement - no sending units or building things outside of boundaries. [/p][/*][*][p]Left shift + click to build 5 units at a time at any building [/p][/*][*][p]Smarter Pz4 behavior in tutorial, will chase anything you throw at it etc. Different AI than skirmish AI that handles it[/p][/*][*][p]Improved P-47 visual[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] Bug fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Windows Accessibility Pointer Size Glitch - Cursor size now increases or decreases when entering into the game or exiting to adjust size [/p][/*][*][p]When adjusting camera rotation and using minimap to pan, camera would zoom in or out by itself, no longer the case [/p][/*][*][p]Supply depot team color strip visual glitch [/p][/*][*][p]Trying to place a building and clicking UI caused issues like building indicator not going away[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]V0.1.455[/b][/p][p][/p][p]New things: [/p][list][*][p]Feedback system[/p][/*][*][p]Bofors and AT gun now knock down trees[/p][/*][*][p]More tips in loading screen[/p][/*][*][p]Loading screen is now fully translated[/p][/*][*][p]Bunker falls a bit faster during destruction[/p][/*][*][p]Planes that can be called in for support now arrive faster and scout plane is in general a bit faster as well[/p][/*][/list][p] Bug fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Mouse click not working after cancelling buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Building visualizers can persist if some bugs occur or external software cause issues, should no longer be the case[/p][/*][*][p]In some instances artillery call in explosion particles didn't get reset[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DEVELOPER UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
For those who want to see some footage of the game, the wait is over! Here's a video with some of the starting gameplay! Please note that this is pre-alpha footage and there will be changes.

[previewyoutube=E5nSFgKJz8Q;full][/previewyoutube]


I've been making some good progress! Below are some of the new additions made to the game :) 

• Improved unit dynamic target selection
• Fixed vehicle explosion sizes
• New vehicle destruction effects(metal pieces that fly in the air)
• Fixed bug where in some cases vehicle HMG keeps firing after death
• Added tooltip hover system


Additionally here's footage of the new destruction effect for vehicles!

[previewyoutube=XfgkoWUhW08;full][/previewyoutube]
